references.text: God's original instruction to Moses to make eleven curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle. Exodus 36:14 describes the execution of this command.
Detailed instructions on the dimensions and joining of the goat hair curtains, which are carried out in Exodus 36:14-18.
The women who spun goat hair with their skill and delivered the material used to make the curtains mentioned in Exodus 36:14.
The responsibility of the Gershonites for carrying the tabernacle's curtains, including the goat hair curtains made in Exodus 36:14.
